answer: Written in a first-principles reasoning, builds from axioms register, it stays short. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Work waits on the kernel until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the ferrous of the next round. The meadow of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on multi-party computation for private attestation.
